description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Last Stand], [Haste] and [Astra], removes negative effects, grants [Awoken Potion] to the user

description.name: Awoken Potion
description.text: White Magic abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for White Magic abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Custom Potion after using a White Magic ability

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle

description.name: Astra
description.text: Prevents Poison, Silence, Paralyze, Confuse, Slow, Stop, Blind, Sleep, Petrify, Berserk, Sap and Stun once
